ON OCTOBER 28, 2026 EX-99.1 Palvella Announces FDA Acceptance and Priority Review of QTORIN™ Rapamycin NDA; February 28, 2027 PDUFA Target Action Date Set QTORIN™ rapamycin could become the first FDA-approved therapy for microcystic lymphatic malformations, a serious, lifelong rare disease affecting an estimated more than 30,000 diagnosed children and adults in the U.S.
The FDA has assigned a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of February 28, 2027.
With compelling Phase 3 SELVA results and a February 28, 2027 PDUFA target action date, we believe we are closer than ever to delivering on that mission.
